instruction: A candid outdoor photograph in a medium shot captures a hiking scene on a sandy trail with green shrubs under bright daylight. On the right, the man in the red plaid shirt (R1) leans forward, looking down with a supportive smile as he extends his hand. On the left, the blonde woman in the grey t-shirt (R2) climbs the sandy slope with her back partially turned. They are holding hands as the man (R1) helps the woman (R2) ascend. The scene is bathed in warm, natural light with soft shadows and a shallow depth of field.
